title: Andy Kirk's band: smooth, clean and Pha Terrell's singing
summary: Tate calls the Kirk band sweet and recorded well; Kirk's Denver connection with Whiteman.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Was Andy Kirk's band highly regarded? The musicians?
Despite the Pha Terrell vocal or-----

Yeah, it was more of a sweet, smooth band. Actually, it wasn't a band like the Bennie Moten band or the Basie band, but very, very clean and recorded very well because they were light and they recorded perfectly. I mean, they were beautiful for recording. And Pha was a beautiful singer and that's what really made them. Everything they did with Pha singing was a hit.
Wasn't Andy at one time associated with the same school as Whiteman in Denver?

Yeah, out in -- yeah, with Paul out in Denver. He's from Denver. Yeah, yeah, that's right. He was a -- seemed like -- I think now that he took lessons from Paul's father or something, but they were associated. They were very close together. He's from Denver. That's true.

So, you know, it didn't never worry me because I always felt that -- you know, I don't ever blame myself for something I don't know, you know. Hell, I didn't know. I went the way I felt, you know, I wasn't ready to leave then. I wanted to stay out there and I ended up -- I'm glad the way it did, because I ended up with Basie, who I would much rather prefer to be with than Andy. I loved Andy and all the guys --
